moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins today, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Opening Day Buzz
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off today. Who are you backing for the title this year? #PremierLeague

angles.name: Arsenal's Title Defence
angles.copy: Defending champions Arsenal start their campaign at home against newly promoted Coventry City tonight. Can they get off to a winning start? #COYG

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz and UK club culture, is running from August 20-23 in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is bringing the best of jazz and UK club culture to Dorset this weekend! Who's there soaking up the vibes? #WeOutHere

angles.name: Gilles Peterson's Picks
angles.copy: Curated by the legendary Gilles Peterson, We Out Here Festival is a must for any jazz and electronic music fan. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Dua Lipa!
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa turns 31 today, August 22nd, 2026. She was born in 1995.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa today! What's your favourite track from her? #DuaLipa

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: From 'New Rules' to 'Radical Optimism', Dua Lipa has dominated the charts. Join us in celebrating her 31st birthday! 🎉

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie's Chart Debut
moments.blurb: The new collaboration 'Love Sensation' by Madonna and Kylie Minogue debuted at number 8 on the UK Singles Chart last week, marking a significant entry for both pop icons.

angles.name: Pop Royalty Unite
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue together on one track?! 'Love Sensation' hit the Top 10 last week, proving these queens still reign. Have you heard it?

angles.name: Chart Comeback
angles.copy: A new Top 10 hit for both Madonna (her 65th!) and Kylie (her 37th!). 'Love Sensation' is officially a smash. What a collaboration!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Returns Next Week
moments.blurb: One of the UK's biggest electronic dance music festivals, Creamfields, takes over Daresbury, Cheshire from August 27-30, 2026, featuring world-class DJs and immersive production.

angles.name: Countdown to Creamfields
angles.copy: Just one week until Creamfields 2026! Get ready for Disclosure, Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia and more. Who are you buzzing to see? #Creamfields

angles.name: Dance Anthem Destination
angles.copy: Daresbury is about to become the epicentre of electronic music. Creamfields brings the biggest names in dance next weekend! What's your essential festival track?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Next Weekend
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals are set for August 28-30, 2026, bringing a massive lineup of rock, pop, hip hop, and indie artists to Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park.

angles.name: Reading & Leeds Prep

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: From rock to pop to hip hop, Reading & Leeds have it all. Chase & Status, Florence + The Machine, Blossoms are all set to play! What's your must-see act?

moments.title: Victorious Festival in Portsmouth

angles.name: Beautifully Located
